fields.Affiliation / University: Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women
fields.Approval / Accreditation: Government Delhi State University; NAAC A+ (official 2026 MBA brochure)
fields.Intake — Published:
75 regular MBA seats + 1 supernumerary Kashmiri Migrant seat (official 2026-27 brochure)
Published numeric intake: 75
fields.Fees — Published:
₹2.96 lakh academic charges (₹1.41 L year 1 + ₹1.55 L year 2), plus ₹2,000 one-time alumni fee; ₹5,000 refundable security and hostel/mess extra.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 2.98
fields.Fee Scope: Two-year academic charges plus nonrefundable alumni fee; refundable security and residence excluded.
fields.Accepted Exams: CAT 2025 / MAT 2025 / MAT 2026, under the official 2026 brochure
fields.CAT / Exam Cutoff: Official CMAC third-round General/GNGN closing allotment rank 256 for 2026–28. This is an allotment rank, not a CAT percentile.
fields.Eligibility: Female graduate with 60% aggregate; 10 percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST/PD and 5 points for OBC-NCL/CW; valid CAT/MAT score.
fields.Selection Process: CAT-2025 percentile 70% + personal interview 30%; after CAT candidates are exhausted, best MAT-2025/2026 percentile 70% + PI 30%. Mandatory document verification; CMAC merit, preferences and category seats govern allotment.
fields.Placement Scope: MBA-only outcomes not located; do not use university/B.Tech salaries
fields.Top Recruiters: Naukri; Tata Power; Resurgent India; EY; Urban Company; PwC; Capgemini; Deloitte; Airtel; India Infrastructure; Republic; Innova Solutions; American Express; HDFC Bank; KPMG; Jubilant Ingrevia (logos in MBA 2026 brochure; outcome year unstated).
fields.Programme-Aligned Career Paths: Business/Strategy Consultant; Product/Program Manager; Operations; Sales/Brand; Finance Analyst
fields.Notes: Official 2026 brochure confirms 75 regular seats, ₹2.98 L nonrefundable academic/alumni charges over two years, and CAT/MAT eligibility. MBA-only salary statistics were not found. Engineering/university-wide packages are excluded.
fields.Fee Evidence: Official CMAC notice confirms academic charges ₹1,41,000 + ₹1,55,000 = ₹2.96 L, plus one-time alumni fee ₹2,000. Refundable security ₹5,000 and hostel/mess are separate.
fields.Current Audit Note: 18 Oct 2026 public-source review. Checked: Women’s university MBA identity; 75 regular seats plus 1 KM seat, Academic fee ₹2.96 L plus ₹0.02 L alumni charge; refundable security and hostel separate, Female graduate eligibility and CAT/MAT 70% + PI 30% selection, GNGN closing allotment rank 256. Fee and admission details are independently corroborated by CMAC text PDFs while the institution brochure is scanned.
